Ftz-F1 regulates a set of genes that includes both regulators of the segmentation program and genes directly involved in the morphological changes that occur during gastrulation and germ band retraction.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have identified a number of new target genes for Ftz-FtzF1, including a number of genes with important functions during morphogenesis and patterning.

we used microarray analysis to identify genes whose expression depends on both ftz-f1 and ftz, then used ChIP-chip and enhancer reporter constructs to identify the enhancers that control their expression.

Ftz-F1, in combination with Ftz, activates the expression of a large number of genes, some directly involved in morphogenesis and others encoding regulatory proteins that are expressed in a segmentally repeated pattern.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have identified a new set Ftz-F1 responsive genes and enhancers that are regulated by both Ftz-F1, and Ftz.
the Ftz-F1 protein is a master regulator of gene expression in the early embryo.
the Ftz/FtzF1 system is a powerful mechanism for generating spatially restricted patterns of gene expression.
